title: Fixed-depth latent recurrence
hypothesis: Repeating a shared latent block improves compositional reasoning under matched FLOPs.
required_test: Toy graph traversal, parity and nested Boolean tasks across unseen depth; vary 1/2/4/8 recurrent steps.
baselines: Nonrecurrent equal-FLOP network and explicit intermediate-token reasoning.
metrics: OOD exact match vs depth, FLOPs, runtime, 3+ seeds.
falsification: No OOD gain against strong equal-cost control.

title: Predictive cycle budgets
hypothesis: An input-conditioned router selects recurrent depths more efficiently than a fixed budget.
required_test: Generate tasks with varied known difficulty; train router on held-out best-budget labels; evaluate at fixed mean FLOPs.
baselines: Fixed mean budget; random allocation; oracle upper bound.
metrics: Accuracy vs actual FLOPs/latency and budget-prediction regret.
falsification: No Pareto improvement or oracle gap closed negligibly.

title: Intermediate stream communication
hypothesis: Exchanging partial latent states improves results beyond independent streams + voting.
required_test: Train 2-stream network with gated cross-attention; test with communication ablated, shuffled and delayed at inference.
baselines: Two independent streams + vote; late fusion; one serial loop at matched FLOPs.
metrics: Accuracy, failure correlation, cross-message causal effects, FLOPs, latency.
falsification: Gain disappears vs voting/serial loop or after message scrambling.

title: Communication timing
hypothesis: Early or intermediate exchange is more useful than final-only fusion for dependency-heavy tasks.
required_test: Insert information that stream 2 needs from stream 1 at variable step; sweep exchange cycles.
baselines: Always communicate; only final fusion; no exchange.
metrics: Accuracy on staged dependency tasks; message bytes/latency.
falsification: No extra benefit from intermediate exchange.

title: Complementary latent specialisation
hypothesis: Streams can learn nonredundant solution methods without human-assigned roles.
required_test: Evaluate stream-specific error overlap and task transfer with and without diversity regulariser.
baselines: Identical initialisation; unspecialised streams; independent samples.
metrics: Error correlation, intervention importance, cross-task performance.
falsification: Representations differ but accuracy does not improve.

title: Router load balancing
hypothesis: Occupancy regularisation prevents collapse without forcing useless streams.
required_test: Sweep router entropy/load regularisation on varied tasks; inspect assignments and downstream utility.
baselines: No regularisation; uniform mandatory routing.
metrics: Active streams, useful contribution, cost-adjusted accuracy.
falsification: Balanced allocation with no generalisation or cost benefit.

title: Requests as underallocation labels
hypothesis: Only *successful* extra-cycle requests improve future allocation prediction.
required_test: Allow requests during teacher rollouts; label when marginal answer improvement occurs; distil initial router.
baselines: Penalise all requests; no request signal; full oracle sweep.
metrics: Held-out regret vs compute cost; false request rate.
falsification: Initial budget prediction does not improve.

title: Budget-conditioned router
hypothesis: One model can adapt to compute ceilings without separate retraining.
required_test: Train with multiple budget tokens and vary ceilings at test time.
baselines: Dedicated per-budget routers; fixed policy.
metrics: Pareto dominance and calibration at unseen budgets.
falsification: Conditioning adds no benefit or collapses low budget.

title: Adaptive stopping
hypothesis: A learned stopping rule avoids wasted cycles without truncating hard tasks.
required_test: Label marginal benefit of extra loops on task family; train stop head and calibrate abstention.
baselines: Fixed steps; confidence threshold; oracle stop.
metrics: Accuracy and expected cycles; false stops on hard cases.
falsification: False stops eliminate efficiency advantage.

title: Controller overhead
hypothesis: Net benefit persists after router and synchronisation overhead.
required_test: Profile actual GPU kernels for 1/2/4 streams and overlap scheduling, including routing.
baselines: Naive serial loops; batched replicas with voting.
metrics: Wall-clock, GPU occupancy, peak VRAM and Joules.
falsification: Reduced theoretical FLOPs but worsened latency/energy.

title: Long-horizon state integrity
hypothesis: Recurrent stream state retains long causal dependencies without external token traces.
required_test: Staged delayed-variable tasks with context separation; intervene by zeroing hidden state.
baselines: External scratchpad, chain-of-thought, recurrent no-memory.
metrics: Exact match by delay, state perturbation effect.
falsification: No benefit beyond a summary/scratchpad.

title: Train-time branching versus inference branching
hypothesis: Distilling exploratory branching into initial allocations retains quality with lower scheduler overhead.
required_test: Train with branch requests and teacher search; compare deploy static allocation vs adaptive branch.
baselines: Adaptive branch at test; fixed router; supervised labels only.
metrics: End-to-end latency, FLOPs, accuracy.
falsification: Static allocation loses most gain.

title: Sparse memory index with pointers
hypothesis: A small semantic/index representation can trigger retrieval of otherwise inaccessible exact facts.
required_test: Generate long episodic records with rare delayed relevance; retain index plus exact source store.
baselines: Recency, embedding search, keyword index, full-context oracle.
metrics: Recall@k, answer accuracy, index bytes, rare-fact miss.
falsification: Miss rate increases disproportionately for rare facts.

title: Predictive KV-page prefetch
hypothesis: Past queries/activations predict future page demand early enough to hide transfer latency.
required_test: Collect attention-page traces; train low-capacity predictor to prefetch at horizon 1/2/4; simulate measured PCIe latencies.
baselines: LRU, recency, reactive query-aware, perfect-foresight oracle.
metrics: Stall ms, wasted bytes, hit@k, task-loss proxy, simulation sensitivity.
falsification: No improvement after bandwidth and prediction overhead.
estimate_not_measured: Best first candidate; CPU trace study

title: Query-aware KV page selection
hypothesis: Quest-style page statistics beat recency eviction for delayed-relevance tasks on local hardware.
required_test: Reimplement page importance from key extrema/query; test fixed page budgets and delayed needles.
baselines: LRU, random, last-k, full exact attention.
metrics: Top-k target coverage, task accuracy, page-scan cost.
falsification: Equivalent or worse than simple baseline.

title: Bounded index plus exact archive
hypothesis: Full source storage with compact index reduces active KV without irreversible detail loss.
required_test: Small model executes long Q&A with external exact retrieval and fixed hot cache; permute rare-fact placements.
baselines: Summary-only memory; retriever without hot cache; full-context if fits.
metrics: Exact-fact recall, peak VRAM, I/O latency.
falsification: Archive cannot be found in time or retrieval cost dominates.

title: Cache-version metadata
hypothesis: Versions and state fingerprints prevent invalid reuse of cached representations.
required_test: Construct cache blocks under modified weights, positions and prefixes; attempt use with/without validation.
baselines: Unchecked cache reuse.
metrics: Mismatch detection; false acceptance/rejection; end-to-end correctness.
falsification: Validator permits incompatible reuse.

title: KV offload threshold
hypothesis: Offload yields lower peak VRAM when KV exceeds working budget, without excessive latency.
required_test: Sweep context and concurrency; memory-gated CPU/offload; distinguish prefill/decode and host RAM.
baselines: GPU-only, recomputation, simpler paging.
metrics: Peak VRAM, p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, bytes transferred.
falsification: Slowdown outweighs added feasible capacity.

title: Retrieve or recompute decision
hypothesis: Hardware-aware choice between DMA KV and recomputation outperforms either fixed policy.
required_test: Measure transfer and recompute times over block sizes; train simple decision tree and verify held-out workloads.
baselines: Always-fetch, always-recompute, hand-coded threshold.
metrics: Latency / energy at same correctness.
falsification: A fixed threshold matches learned model.

title: Prefetch based on latent signals
hypothesis: Intermediate activations add predictive information beyond recent page access.
required_test: Extract hidden/query projections prior to attention; compare trace predictor with and without latent features.
baselines: Markov past-access predictor; query-only; oracle.
metrics: Out-of-distribution recall@k, stall and model overhead.
falsification: No gain over access-history-only features.

title: Sparse attention fidelity
hypothesis: Approximating with top-k pages maintains task quality within memory budget.
required_test: Run selected-page inference at 10/25/50% pages with exact reference where feasible.
baselines: Full attention; recency and random selection.
metrics: Logit KL, target accuracy, VRAM, decode time.
falsification: Rare fact failures or degradation exceed preset margin.

title: Softmax remote partition merge
hypothesis: Distributed partial attention can reproduce dense attention to numerical tolerance.
required_test: Generate disjoint K/V partitions and merge outputs via log-sum-exp; compare torch dense attention.
baselines: Unnormalised average/naive sum.
metrics: Max abs/relative error in fp32/fp16, operation bytes.
falsification: Cannot reproduce expected tolerance across tested shapes.

title: Cold-memory thrashing
hypothesis: Page-level history or hysteresis prevents oscillation under alternating topics.
required_test: Synthetic queries switch between memory clusters; compare eviction/prefetch policies.
baselines: Pure LRU, no hysteresis.
metrics: Faults/sec, bytes moved, task errors.
falsification: Policy oscillates or incurs higher cost.

title: Memory-constrained scheduling
hypothesis: Moving compute toward memory beats moving KV for repeated remote accesses under favourable bandwidth.
required_test: Cost model with measured transfer/KV sizes; optional multi-node simulator.
baselines: Always move memory; always recompute.
metrics: Cost / delay by topology; sensitivity plots.
falsification: No feasible operating regime for single-node budget.
estimate_not_measured: Simulation only; real multi-GPU out of scope

title: Sleep-trigger policy
hypothesis: Consolidating when retrieval interference rises beats fixed-period consolidation.
required_test: Sequential-memory simulation, schedule compaction by measured misses/pressure.
baselines: Fixed interval, never, always.
metrics: Future recall, compaction time, storage footprint.
falsification: Trigger adds overhead without reducing future error.

title: Consolidation vs summarisation
hypothesis: Reorganised episodic index improves delayed recall more than summary-only memory.
required_test: Sequential episodes with rare changing facts; compare exact archive + indexed consolidation to summaries.
baselines: Raw retrieval, fixed summaries, full-history oracle.
metrics: Answer accuracy by age/frequency, retention bytes.
falsification: No gain over exact retrieval or high rare-fact loss.

title: Rare-fact retention
hypothesis: Novelty and uncertainty plus recurrence protect long-tail information better than frequency-only pruning.
required_test: Plant sparse critical facts and repeated misleading facts, impose fixed storage budget.
baselines: LRU, LFU, random, uniform reservoir.
metrics: Rare-critical recall, total storage, false-belief rate.
falsification: Novelty policy worse than reservoir.

title: Rehearsal reduces forgetting
hypothesis: Small diverse replay improves retention after sequential updates relative to no replay.
required_test: Train tiny adapter sequentially on domains A/B/C with protected test splits.
baselines: No replay; reservoir replay; EWC/regularised adapters if feasible.
metrics: A accuracy after B/C, B/C accuracy, update FLOPs.
falsification: Replay cost outweighs retention benefit.

title: Adapter-only consolidation
hypothesis: Freezing backbone and updating small memory modules gives safer retention than full-model updates.
required_test: Same training data and budgets, compare adapter vs full-model modifications at toy scale.
baselines: No weight updates; full tuning.
metrics: Protected regression, new-task gain, rollback correctness.
falsification: No advantage in retention/cost.

title: Protected checkpoint rollback
hypothesis: Automated independent evaluation prevents acceptance of harmful online updates.
required_test: Inject known degradations into candidate adapters; run protected unseen tests and rollback.
baselines: Manual acceptance; train-loss-only gate.
metrics: Detection recall, false rejects, recovery time.
falsification: Misses known regressions or gate overfits.

title: Consolidation cost accounting
hypothesis: Sleep improves net lifetime quality only when update cost is amortised.
required_test: Compare cost of repeated retrieval vs periodic compaction under projected number of future queries.
baselines: Never sleep; regular compaction; cache only.
metrics: Cumulative task utility / full lifecycle joules, storage.
falsification: Payback horizon exceeds workload.

title: Stable beliefs under synthetic replay
hypothesis: Replay needs provenance to avoid self-reinforcing false records.
required_test: Mix verified and model-generated episodes with controlled falsehoods; consolidate with vs without provenance gating.
baselines: Ungated replay; external-only replay.
metrics: False belief persistence, accurate recall, update FLOPs.
falsification: Reinforcement of synthetic errors increases.

title: Joint compute+memory routing
hypothesis: Joint allocation improves the Pareto frontier beyond independent routers.
required_test: Only after A/B positive; train joint vs separate controllers on coupled delayed-dependency tasks.
baselines: Independent routers; fixed resource split.
metrics: Accuracy / compute/VRAM/latency frontier.
falsification: Interaction terms nonpositive or unstable.

title: Resource competition value
hypothesis: Explicit shared budget yields useful trade-offs among streams, hot KV, and consolidation.
required_test: Compare fixed partitions and global allocation on tasks varying in memory versus reasoning demands.
baselines: Independent fixed budgets and oracle allocations.
metrics: Total utility at equal global cost.
falsification: No additional gain after overhead.

title: Integration fragility
hypothesis: Full system remains robust to changing context distributions and simultaneous load.
required_test: Shift prompt topics, sequence length and traffic; stress controllers after held-out training.
baselines: Best simple production architecture.
metrics: p95/99 latency, accuracy regressions, OOM rate.
falsification: Catastrophic tail failures or instability.

title: Scale-transfer evidence
hypothesis: Effects seen in toy or 0.5B models remain directional at a larger feasible checkpoint.
required_test: Repeat top result at two sizes, matched relative resources and data.
baselines: Single size extrapolation.
metrics: Effect sizes/CI versus size and data.
falsification: Gain changes sign or vanishes.
